title: Date Functions — Current Date
description: Use GETDATE() and DATEDIFF to calculate employee tenure.

data.text: Write a query to calculate how many years each employee has been with the company, based on their HireDate.

data.title: SQL Solution
data.code:
SELECT
    EmployeeID,
    FirstName,
    LastName,
    HireDate,
    DATEDIFF(YEAR, HireDate, GETDATE()) AS YearsOfService
FROM Employees
ORDER BY YearsOfService DESC;

data.title: Explanation
data.text: GETDATE() returns the current date and time. DATEDIFF(interval, start, end) returns the count of the specified date boundary crossed. DATEDIFF(YEAR, ...) counts year boundaries crossed — it is not exact age in years. For exact fractional years, use DATEDIFF(DAY, ...)/365.25.
